title: OAuthLib: Token grants can use attacker-supplied client_id for authorization after authenticating a different client…
description: OAuthLib contains a vulnerability in its token grant handlers where an authenticated low-privilege client can supply a different client_id in the token request body. This causes grant and scope validation to be performed under the attacker-supplied client_id rather than the authenticated client's identity. The flaw affects the client_credentials and password grant flows. The impact is that a lower-privilege client can obtain tokens with scopes or grant types assigned to a higher-privilege client. A fix is available in version 13.8.0_3.
